# Commits deliberately not backported, so the report stops flagging them.
#
# Format, one per line:
#   <subject>                  ignore for every target branch
#   <target-branch>::<subject> ignore for one target branch only
#
# Subjects are matched exactly, so paste the commit title verbatim.
# Blank lines and lines starting with # are ignored.

# 4.2.x has no init_mysql_db/init_pgsql_db, so these cannot apply there.
release/4.2.x::fix(docker): pass MySQL password via defaults file instead of command line (refs #1318)
release/4.2.x::fix(docker): build psql port argument as an array
release/4.2.x::fix(docker): optionally initialize PowerDNS schema for empty MySQL/PostgreSQL databases
release/4.2.x::fix(docker): initialize MySQL/PostgreSQL schema on fresh container start (closes #1307)

# These fix the SSO env var mapping feature, which 4.2.x does not ship. One also
# edits the 4.3.0 migration files, which do not exist on 4.2.x.
release/4.2.x::fix(auth): safer SSO template revocation and backward-compatible env var parsing
release/4.2.x::fix(auth): address review feedback for SSO template management

# 4.2.x never had the api.log_requests setting, so there is nothing to remove.
release/4.2.x::fix(docker): remove dead api.log_requests config from entrypoint
